verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a knowledge-base app, but the evidence shows no user-configurable automation or scheduling feature in Logseq. The plugin API, local HTTP server, and logseq:// protocol are developer building blocks a user could use to build automations externally. The midnight Journals page creation is a fixed built-in behavior, not an automation the user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
